# scoop-boot package list (delivered by scoop-boot.ps1 --update; do not edit): the
# devel profile, used when etc\packages\<hostname>.txt does not exist. One manifest
# per line in install order; "#" starts a comment; "bucket/name" is passed to Scoop as
# written. --admin-init and --profile compose etc\packages\<hostname>.txt from the
# profiles under etc\profiles (lower case host name): it replaces this file completely
# and is never touched by --update. Bootstrap packages (7zip, git, aria2, sudo,
# innounp, dark, lessmsi, wget, cacert) are installed before this list and are not
# listed here. A line "# bucket NAME URL" adds a bucket in Step 2 before the packages
# (--import writes such lines). Packages with a post-install step (Step 4):
# vcredist2022 temurin25-jdk msys2 nmap 7zip notepadplusplus vscode python314 git
# jetbrains-toolbox greenshot (see scoop-boot.ps1 --list-packages).
# Profiles: base, desktop, ide, cli, svn, java, node, perl, python, c++, docs, network, db, server, azure, media
# ---- profile base ----
# System libraries (first: VC++ runtime, post_install asks for elevation once)
vcredist2022

# Git tools (Git itself is a bootstrap package) and OpenSSH
openssh
gh
lazygit

# ---- profile desktop ----
# Browsers
firefox
googlechrome

# Editors
vscode
